<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="אייר_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518918601_theRebbe_37" batchId="meluket-_D7_90_D7_99_D7_99_D7_A8_meluket__BH_POST_1766518918601_theRebbe_37__p002">
  <section v="3">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that within the wonders of the Torah (its inner dimension) there are two levels, corresponding to the soul and soul-within-soul of the Torah, as taught in the Zohar.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">3)</t>
    <t s="1">And it is explained in the maamar,</t>
    <t s="2">that in the wonders of the Torah</t>
    <t s="3">(the inner dimension of the Torah)</t>
    <t s="4">there are two levels.</t>
    <t s="5">And the concept is,</t>
    <t s="6">that it is brought in the Zohar</t>
    <t s="7">that the Torah has a garment,</t>
    <t s="8">a body,</t>
    <t s="9">a soul, and a soul to the soul.</t>
    <t s="10">The revealed aspect of Torah is the garment and body of Torah</t>
    <t s="11">[the stories of Torah — the garment,</t>
    <t s="12">and the laws of Torah — the body],</t>
    <t s="13">and the soul of Torah is the inner dimension of Torah,</t>
    <t s="14">which is generally divided into two levels.</t>
    <t s="15">The secrets of Torah</t>
    <t s="16">(concealed)</t>
    <t s="17">— the soul,</t>
    <t s="18">and the secrets of secrets</t>
    <t s="19">(the most hidden of all hidden)</t>
    <t s="20">— the soul to the soul.</t>
    <t s="21">And the request "Unveil my eyes and I will behold wonders from Your Torah"</t>
    <t s="22">(wonders in the plural)</t>
    <t s="23">is that he should see the two levels of wonders in the Torah,</t>
    <t s="24">the secrets and the secrets of secrets.</t>
    <t s="25">And it explains,</t>
    <t s="26">that the soul is the level of Nefesh-Ruach-Neshamah,</t>
    <t s="27">and the soul to the soul is the level of Chayah-Yechidah.</t>
    <t s="28">And perhaps it can be said,</t>
    <t s="29">that the matters of the inner dimension of Torah that Rashbi revealed throughout all the days of his life</t>
    <t s="30">are the level of the soul of the Torah,</t>
    <t s="31">and the matters he revealed on the day of his passing</t>
    <t s="32">are the level of the soul to the soul.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="4">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section discusses the Tzemach Tzedek's commentary on the verse, explaining that the request is to see the soul of the Torah, and that the Shelah's interpretation regarding the intent of the mitzvos is related to this understanding.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And behold, in the notes of the Tzemach Tzedek on Tehillim on the verse "Unveil my eyes and I will behold wonders from Your Torah,"</t>
    <t s="1">he brings the aforementioned statement of the Zohar that the Torah has a garment, a body, a soul, and a soul to the soul,</t>
    <t s="2">and explains,</t>
    <t s="3">that the request "Unveil my eyes and I will behold wonders" is that he should see not only the garment alone but also the soul.</t>
    <t s="4">And in the continuation of the matter, he brings the interpretation of the Shelah</t>
    <t s="5">that "I will behold wonders" refers to the intent of the mitzvos.</t>
    <t s="6">And after he brings the interpretation of the Shelah, he continues to explain that "wonders" is the inner dimension of Torah,</t>
    <t s="7">the soul of the Torah.</t>
    <t s="8">And it needs to be understood,</t>
    <t s="9">for seemingly, he should have first concluded the explanation of the interpretation that "wonders" is the soul of the Torah, and afterwards brought another interpretation that "wonders" is the intent of the mitzvos,</t>
    <t s="10">and from the fact that he brings this interpretation in the middle of the explanation that "wonders" is the soul of the Torah,</t>
    <t s="11">it implies,</t>
    <t s="12">that the interpretation that "wonders" is the intent of the mitzvos is relevant to the explanation and understanding of the interpretation that "I will behold wonders" means he will see the soul of the Torah.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="5">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the request "Unveil my eyes" is for the revelation to come from the person's own side, analogous to the giving of the Torah where the ultimate purpose was for the lower ones to ascend to the upper ones.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">4)</t>
    <t s="1">And this will be understood by prefacing what is said, "Unveil my eyes," etc., that he asks from the Holy One, blessed be He, to open his eyes,</t>
    <t s="2">for seemingly,</t>
    <t s="3">since the reason that ordinarily one does not see the wonders of the Torah is</t>
    <t s="4">(not due to a deficiency of the vessels,</t>
    <t s="5">but rather)</t>
    <t s="6">because the wonders are hidden and concealed</t>
    <t s="7">[and it can be said,</t>
    <t s="8">that the concealment of the level of the soul of the Torah is because it is clothed in the body of the Torah</t>
    <t s="9">(the revealed aspect of Torah)</t>
    <t s="10">which conceals the soul,</t>
    <t s="11">and the concealment of the level of the soul to the soul of the Torah is</t>
    <t s="12">(not that it is clothed in something that conceals it,</t>
    <t s="13">but rather)</t>
    <t s="14">that in its own essence it is in concealment,</t>
    <t s="15">a concealment that is above revelation],</t>
    <t s="16">he should have asked that the Holy One, blessed be He, reveal the wonders of the Torah,</t>
    <t s="17">and what is the request "Unveil my eyes," that the Holy One, blessed be He, should open his eyes?</t>
    <t s="18">And the point of the explanation of this,</t>
    <t s="19">according to what is brought in the Midrash,</t>
    <t s="20">A parable of a king who decreed and said: The residents of Rome shall not go down to Syria, and the residents of Syria shall not go up to Rome,</t>
    <t s="21">so too, when the Holy One, blessed be He, created the world, He decreed and said: "The heavens are the heavens of the L-rd, and the earth He gave to the children of man,"</t>
    <t s="22">when He desired to give the Torah, He nullified the decree and said: The lower ones shall ascend to the upper ones, and the upper ones shall descend to the lower ones,</t>
    <t s="23">and I will begin,</t>
    <t s="24">as it is stated,</t>
    <t s="25">"And the L-rd descended upon Mount Sinai," and it is written,</t>
    <t s="26">"And to Moshe He said, 'Ascend to the L-rd.'"</t>
    <t s="27">And it is explained elsewhere,</t>
    <t s="28">that the reason it says "the lower ones shall ascend to the upper ones" before "the upper ones shall descend to the lower ones,"</t>
    <t s="29">even though the descent of the upper ones below occurred first,</t>
    <t s="30">"I will begin,"</t>
    <t s="31">is,</t>
    <t s="32">because the ultimate intent of the giving of the Torah is that the lower ones shall ascend to the upper ones</t>
    <t s="33">[that they should become vessels for the revelation of G-dliness,</t>
    <t s="34">and moreover, that even the drawing down of the revelation within them should be from their own side and through their service],</t>
    <t s="35">except that in order for the ascent of the lower ones above to be possible, it is through the descent of the upper ones below,</t>
    <t s="36">which is the beginning and the empowerment for the ascent of the lower ones above.</t>
    <t s="37">And similarly is it regarding the giving of the Torah of the inner dimension of Torah on Lag BaOmer,</t>
    <t s="38">that the intent in the nullification of the decree and the partition between the upper ones and the lower ones regarding the inner dimension of Torah is,</t>
    <t s="39">that the revelation of the inner dimension of Torah that is drawn down to the person should be</t>
    <t s="40">(also)</t>
    <t s="41">from the person's side.</t>
    <t s="42">And this is "Unveil my eyes and I will behold wonders from Your Torah,"</t>
    <t s="43">that the Holy One, blessed be He, should open the person's eyes and he will see the wonders of the Torah</t>
    <t s="44">(not only through the wonders being revealed,</t>
    <t s="45">but also)</t>
    <t s="46">from the person's own side.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
